probes.name: symbolic-composition
probes.query: which primitive families are worth adding for autonomous composition

data.snippet: What is missing is not a new symbolic AI but three specific closures: programs that carry dataflow, a bounded planner that assembles programs from goals, and an executor that actually runs the program it compiled. Highest-value primitive family: natural-language-in. Second: a small set of logic glue primitives. Physics: no — zero demand, zero detectors, zero corpus, and primitive admission is demand-gated by policy.
